title: Word dictionary with wildcard
statementMd:
Simulate a dictionary: `['add', word]` and `['search', pattern]` where `.` in the pattern matches any one letter. Return the results of the search operations.

**Example:** `wildcard_dictionary([["add", "bad"], ["add", "dad"], ["add", "mad"], ["search",…)` returns `[false, true, true, true]`.
